views.VIEW_DEFINITION: select `f`.`forecast_id` AS `forecast_id`,`rv`.`name` AS `variety`,`c`.`crop_id` AS `crop_id`,`s`.`name` AS `season`,`f`.`forecast_date` AS `forecast_date`,`f`.`estimated_quantity` AS `estimated_quantity`,`f`.`method` AS `method`,`h`.`quantity` AS `actual_quantity`,(case when (`h`.`harvest_id` is not null) then 'Evaluated' else 'Pending' end) AS `forecast_status`,(case when (`h`.`harvest_id` is not null) then abs((`f`.`estimated_quantity` - `h`.`quantity`)) else NULL end) AS `absolute_error` from ((((`RoseProductionDB`.`Forecast` `f` join `RoseProductionDB`.`Crop` `c` on((`f`.`crop_id` = `c`.`crop_id`))) join `RoseProductionDB`.`RoseVariety` `rv` on((`c`.`variety_id` = `rv`.`variety_id`))) join `RoseProductionDB`.`Season` `s` on((`f`.`season_id` = `s`.`season_id`))) left join `RoseProductionDB`.`Harvest` `h` on(((`f`.`crop_id` = `h`.`crop_id`) and (`f`.`forecast_date` = `h`.`harvest_date`))))

select count(0) AS `total_forecasts`,sum((case when (`RoseProductionDB`.`vw_forecast_status`.`forecast_status` = 'Evaluated') then 1 else 0 end)) AS `evaluated_forecasts`,sum((case when (`RoseProductionDB`.`vw_forecast_status`.`forecast_status` = 'Pending') then 1 else 0 end)) AS `pending_forecasts`,round(avg(`RoseProductionDB`.`vw_forecast_status`.`absolute_error`),2) AS `MAE`,round(avg((case when (`RoseProductionDB`.`vw_forecast_status`.`forecast_status` = 'Evaluated') then (abs(((`RoseProductionDB`.`vw_forecast_status`.`actual_quantity` - `RoseProductionDB`.`vw_forecast_status`.`estimated_quantity`) / `RoseProductionDB`.`vw_forecast_status`.`actual_quantity`)) * 100) end)),2) AS `MAPE` from `RoseProductionDB`.`vw_forecast_status`
